title: Canonical control payload schemas with explicit target extensions
description: Planning artifact. Validates CloudEvents data, not its envelope. Full producer/private schemas and viewer profiles are separate. Preserve source fields with canonical data.type substitution; ToolCallRefused explicitly adds required exact toolCallId and reason to the target contract. Structural validation does not replace annotated runtime refinements or admission/authority checks.

DateTimeOffset.x-source-format: Zod datetime({ offset: true }); source regex admits optional seconds and compact offsets. Do not replace with stricter RFC3339 date-time assertion.

x-validation-profile.scope: Current owning API producer parse outputs or explicitly preserved server wire contracts, plus the explicit ToolCallRefused call-identity/reason target extension.
x-validation-profile.formats: Assert uri and uuid formats when using these profiles. Payload datetime fields use exact pinned Zod regex; do not apply stricter RFC3339 date-time assertion to source payloads. Envelope time is a separate contract.
x-validation-profile.unknownValues: JsonValue is arbitrary JSON including null, scalars, arrays and objects; JavaScript undefined/functions/symbols/nonfinite numbers are not JSON.
x-validation-profile.requiredness: Defaulted fields are required only in source parse-output profiles. Unknown-valued requiredness follows source behavior, including optional ToolResultSubmission.result.
x-validation-profile.sourceStringSemantics: Zod string lengths count JavaScript UTF-16 code units while standard JSON Schema minLength/maxLength count Unicode code points. For non-BMP content, retain source UTF-16 length checks as supplementary validation. Source trim transforms are parse behavior and do not authorize canonical projection to trim existing data.
x-validation-profile.semanticCompleteness: x-runtime-constraints are mandatory supplementary validators. Standard Draft 2020-12 cannot generally compare sibling numeric values, sort arrays, compare selected object properties across arrays, sum lengths or enforce serialized UTF-8 bytes.
x-validation-profile.privacy: A private $defs member is not a public schema endpoint or permission grant. Viewer projections use publicDataRef.
x-validation-profile.preservation: On projection retain every source payload field apart from canonical type substitution. ToolCallRefused additionally requires trusted event-linked toolCallId and classified reason; without that evidence retain legacy representation. If the selected structural profile fails, do not coerce/drop fields to make it pass. Choose an explicitly reviewed source profile or retain legacy representation.
